blind.description: A stylized low wooden tailor's workbench with four chunky legs and a lower storage shelf. The tabletop features a dark purple cutting mat with a roll of purple cloth unrolled across it, a round red pincushion, a pair of metal tailoring scissors, and an off-white fabric swatch. The lower shelf holds three neatly rolled bolts of cloth colored green, yellow, and red. The geometry is solid, clean, and hand-painted with smooth stylized textures, resting directly on its four wooden feet.
blind.from_above: A clean rectangle showing a warm wood frame enclosing a dark purple surface, with a purple fabric roll along the left side, a small circular red pincushion at top center-left, metal scissors at top center, and a rectangular light cloth scrap on the right.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 40% as tall as the 5 ft 9 in figure (roughly 2.3 ft high), and roughly 4.5 ft long by 3 ft wide.
